scope: Actual production UI modules executed in Node/JSDOM with deliberately controlled DOM composition, input and keyboard events. This report establishes the listed component contracts and existing pure Node regressions, not a native Windows IME or real browser/installer acceptance.

failedCases: axis rejected composition remains invalid through tail input, change and blur, retaining the actual upper bound
axis changes in another field cannot bypass a rejected composition or partially replace the saved range
axis explicit deletion can request Automatic after rejection, while corrected and renewed valid compositions still apply once
axis rejected dimensions cannot change aspect geometry through tail events or another dimension field
axis reset and context replacement clear rejected composition ownership without stranding valid edits
axis candidate termination, neutral navigation and select-all cannot authorize an Automatic limit
axis new pointer editing can recover the same finite value and actual cut can explicitly clear a limit
axis empty composition-end data cannot turn an existing numeric limit into Automatic
axis explicit deletion of a clean empty rejected field requests Automatic even when the browser emits no input
axis explicit deletion never accepts a still-malformed native number or deletes its last valid bound
axis a second cancelled composition retains the first rejected limit and clears earlier edit intentions
axis a renewed finite composition can recover the same displayed value without authorizing a cancelled composition

caseCountBoundary.explanation: The frozen source19 baseline was actually run with 23 groups (13 passed, 10 failed). The two second-composition groups were added later and first run on the intermediate latch fix (23 passed, 2 failed). No hypothetical 13-pass/12-fail source19 result is asserted.

verifiedContracts: Rejected number composition followed by input/change/blur/Enter retains the previous finite bound and prevents preview/commit.
A second cancelled composition, including an earlier deferred deletion intention, cannot convert the rejected blank field to Automatic.
Cross-field edits cannot partially delete a range while any number-composition rejection remains unresolved.
Plot-width/height aspect-lock handling checks rejection before changing the partner dimension.
Different complete finite values can recover without a preceding key event; explicit same-value pointer editing and successful renewed finite composition can recover too.
Enter/Escape/Tab/modifiers/select-all/navigation are not evidence of a new numeric edit.
Explicit Backspace/Delete on a clean empty rejected field requests Automatic even when no subsequent input event occurs; badInput continues to block.
Reset, cancellation and context replacement clear rejected-field ownership and allow later valid edits.
